data.content:
Teutberga
Queen of Lotharingia who died on 11 November 875 and was married to Lothair II.

Lotharingia
The kingdom where Teutberga served as queen.

Lothair II
Husband of Teutberga and ruler associated with Lotharingia.

Boso the Elder
Father of Teutberga and member of the Bosonid family.

Hucbert
Brother of Teutberga and lay-abbot of St. Maurice's Abbey.

St. Maurice's Abbey
Religious institution where Hucbert served as lay-abbot.
